Our Clinic

Located in southwest Edmonton near Windermere, just south of the Anthony Henday, our clinic is easy to access from anywhere in the city. With free patient parking and a welcoming clinic, your visit is always stress-free.

Patient Parking

Patients of Mayra Dental Clinic can enjoy free parking near the building’s west entrance. Limited street parking is also available, just be sure to avoid fire hydrants and no-parking zones.

Visit Us

Welcome to Mayra Dental Clinic, Edmonton’s premier multispecialty dental clinic. Recognized as a centre of excellence, our highly-skilled and experienced dental specialists are leaders in providing cosmetic, reconstructive, and implant dentistry with exceptional care.
